subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the exact-head dependency ownership move and the generic Plugin SDK/Gateway lifecycle seams land together as this stack's second stage?
rationale: Tests establish correctness but cannot decide whether these cross-package and process-wide contracts are the desired permanent ownership boundary or whether maintainers prefer them split before landing.

options.title: Authorize and land this boundary
options.body: Approve the exact dependency graph, rebase onto current main, refresh proof, and merge this stage with the compatibility shim intact.

options.title: Split generic runtime changes
options.body: Move the Plugin SDK and Gateway lifecycle seams into separately reviewed prerequisite PRs before landing the Matrix catalog migration.

options.title: Pause the migration stack
options.body: Keep this and the dependent workflow PR open until dependency ownership and long-term QA runner architecture are agreed.

recommendation.title: Authorize and land this boundary
recommendation.body: Approve the exact dependency graph, rebase onto current main, refresh proof, and merge this stage with the compatibility shim intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the coordinated migration history and can best explain why the generic seams and dependency move belong in this stage, while final authorization still requires the appropriate repository owners.
